fields.Name: IT152 - Video Studio Live Smoke
fields.Description: Opt-in live-model smoke check (VSLS1) for Video Studio: runs a 15-second Social Short under the Draft preset using the active configured render driver and real credentialed models (no generative video unless VS_LIVE_GENERATION=1). Asserts Status='Delivered', a real MP4 FileID in MJ: Files, and rendered duration within 1 second of the spec. Skips loudly when the render driver Health() is unhealthy or PreviewModelSelection finds no credentialed model.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: VSLS1 either delivers a real 15s Social Short MP4 within 1s of target duration or skips loudly with a diagnostic message when the render worker or model credentials are unavailable.
